# Genuine Optimum

> Genuine Optimum is a digital engineering and growth systems company. We build
> web development, SEO, custom software, and AI & data systems as one connected
> system for a business, rather than as separate, siloed vendors.

## What we do

- [Web Development](https://genuineoptimum.com/services/web-development): Fast, scalable, conversion-focused websites and web platforms (React, Next.js, e-commerce).
- [SEO](https://genuineoptimum.com/services/seo): Technical SEO, on-page optimization, local SEO, and link authority development for organic growth.
- [Custom Applications](https://genuineoptimum.com/services/custom-applications): Mobile, web, and SaaS applications, plus internal business systems.
- [AI & Data Systems](https://genuineoptimum.com/services/ai-data-systems): AI chatbots, workflow automation, data dashboards, and predictive models.

## Who we serve

See [Industries](https://genuineoptimum.com/industries) for the specific verticals we work with: local service businesses, e-commerce brands, startups, technology companies, and professional services firms.
